__NOTOC__ Jost is a draenei paladin found in the Exodar when the Burning Legion invaded the capital. He helped Prophet Velen to defend the civilians and after the defeat of the eredar High General Rakeesh, he was present as Velen ordered to prepare for journey home. He later traveled to Argus by the Vindicaar. During the Fourth War, Jost served as a personal bodyguard to Velen. He and his fellow Light's Chosen Divinius would accompany the Prophet during a meeting with Anduin Wrynn and other Alliance leaders in Stormwind Keep, shortly before the Battle for Darkshore.

Juma is a Zandalari troll located inside the Temple of Akunda in Vol'dun. He is initially known as Akunda the Divine and is one of the trolls responsible for keeping Akunda incapacitated, but he resumes his true name and kneels down next to the freed loa after completion of Ending the Madness.

Julwaba is a Zandalari troll quest giver initially located in western Zul'Ahjin in Vol'dun. She is an old friend of Warguard Rakera that willingly traveled to Vol'dun in search of knowledge of the past and has also befriended the sethrak Serrik. After the adventurer finishes their business in Zul'Ahjin, Julwaba travels back to her comrades at the Scorched Sands Outpost and invites the adventurer to join her there if they seek shelter.

After being freed by an adventurer on behalf of First Mate Jamboya, he agrees to aid Jamboya in mutinying against Pirate-King Zem'lan alongside Gunner Bosanya and Quartermaster Tulmac. He accompanies Jamboya to the Golden Isle and later to Camp Lastwind.

Joyous Journeys was a server-wide buff added to realms a few weeks before the 3.4.0 pre-patch began. It persisted until fully launched on 26 September 2022. This buff increased experience gains from all sources and was intended as both a celebration of Kil'jaeden's defeat in BC Classic and a way to help players prepare for Wrath Classic. It was brought back once again for from 13 December 2022 to 16 January 2023 and from 23 May to 19 June 2023, and once again on 5 September 2023 but with no indication of an ending date.

Items that cannot be sold to a vendor NPC for money, disenchanted, or used for a quest, are definitely junk. : One definition includes more: :* Items you do not plan to use, but just sell to a vendor for money or just trash (throw away). Also known as vendor trash. : Alternative definition: :* Items that cannot even be sold to a vendor. This perhaps does not apply so much to WoW, since there are very few items that cannot be sold for at least pocket change. Junkboxes are a type of lootable container that a rogue can pickpocket from a monster. The type of junkbox (and the money/loot contained within) will improve with the monster in question's level. Junkboxes are always locked.

Jumping is an action that characters, mobs, and mounts can do, usually while moving. This action can be used to jump over objects and up to higher level terrain. Jumping usually cancels any action that requires a cast time. The default key press for jumping in-game is the . NPCs and mobs cannot jump but they can still find ways to climb a cliff that would even be impossible to jump up.

K'iru is a naaru located on the second floor of the inn of Sun's Reach Harbor on the Isle of Quel'Danas. He spawns after players have completed all objectives on the Isle and [http://forums.worldofwarcraft.com/thread.html?topicId=6440919572&pageNo=1&sid=1#12 an unknown number of additional daily turn-ins]. Captain Theris Dawnhearth announces his arrival with a zone-wide yell: Our victory in Sun's Reach is absolute! The naaru bless us with their presence! While active, he buffs all players on the Isle of Quel'Danas and in the Magisters' Terrace with K'iru's Song of Victory, increasing Stamina by 79 and Intellect by 40.

The key to this is that in the normal course of the encounter, some of the abominations waiting in the wings will not come out and attack on their own. Send someone to pull a few extras, but beware the banshees!

Justicar Mariel Trueheart is a human quest giver and starts the primary quest chain for questers wishing to participate in the Argent Tournament. She can be found in the western portion of the Argent Tournament Grounds inside the Argent Pavilion. Before the Coliseum was constructed she originally was standing on the floor; she now stands guard mounted on top of an Argent Charger. She was present during Death Rising.
Junat the Wanderer is a taunka quest giver at Camp Winterhoof in Howling Fjord. See Howling Fjord NPCs.

Jun'do the Traitor was a jungle troll working with Zalazane. Vol'jin's Horde strike force encountered him after Bwonsamdi's blessing on the Echo Isles. After a fierce battle Jun'do and his warriors were slain.

Justice Points were rewarded for completion of high level PvE dungeons and raids and used as currency for gear and other rewards that were oriented toward the PvE style of play. Points were commonly rewarded after killing a boss or after completing a dungeon that was initiated using the Dungeon Finder. One requirement is that all participants of the dungeon must conform to level requirements, or else no reward will be given to any participant. Justice Points replaced Emblem of Frost and Emblem of Triumph. Mists of Pandaria based raid content also rewards Valor Points. The cap for Justice Points is 4000. After each patch, Justice Points above the cap are converted to per Justice Point. Justic

Just Another Day in Tol Barad is a simple achievement that just requires you to complete all of the daily quests in Tol Barad and Tol Barad Peninsula. Because the dailies are offered randomly, and several require your faction to control the zone, it may take several days to complete.
